title: Trump says Apple to work with Intel to manufacture chips in US
title_zh: 特朗普称苹果将与英特尔合作在美国生产芯片
summary: President Donald Trump said in a ‌Truth Social post on ‌Thursday that Apple had agreed to ​work with Intel to design and build its chips in the United States.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周四在“Truth Social”帖子中表示，苹果已同意与英特尔合作，在美国设计和制造其芯片。

title: Apple to hike prices as chip shortage bites: WSJ
title_zh: 华尔街日报：苹果因芯片短缺而提高价格
summary: STORY: Apple plans to raise prices for its products as a shortage of memory chips bites.That’s according to Chief Executive Tim Cook in an interview with the Wall Street Journal published Wednesday.A surge in AI-driven demand has left consumer electronics companies battling to...
summary_zh: 故事：由于存储芯片短缺，苹果计划提高其产品价格。首席执行官蒂姆·库克在周三发表的《华尔街日报》采访中表示。人工智能驱动的需求激增，让消费电子公司奋力……

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures edge up after US and Iran sign interim deal
title_zh: 今日股市：美国和伊朗签署临时协议后，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货小幅上涨
summary: US stock futures edged up as Wall Street digested the interim peace deal between the US and Iran as well as the latest Federal Reserve decision on interest rates.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街消化美国和伊朗之间的临时和平协议以及美联储最新的利率决定，美国股指期货小幅上涨。

title: Wall Street closes lower on Fed rate hike bets
title_zh: 美联储加息押注导致华尔街收低

title: Big Tech-backed coalition for carbon removal increases funding by $915 million, adds Anthropic
title_zh: Anthropic 补充道，大型科技公司支持的碳减排联盟增加了 9.15 亿美元的资金
summary: (Removes Salesforce, which is not a new participant but an existing member of the coalition, from paragraph 1) By Susanna Twidale LONDON, June 17 (Reuters) - A coalition backed by Big Tech companies
summary_zh: （从第 1 段中删除 Salesforce，它不是新参与者，而是联盟的现有成员）作者：Susanna Twidale 伦敦，6 月 17 日（路透社）- 由大型科技公司支持的联盟

title: Gaming gets hit by memory shortage: A look at Sandisk's $3K PlayStation 5 SSD
title_zh: 游戏行业因内存短缺而受到打击：Sandisk 售价 3000 美元的 PlayStation 5 SSD 一览
summary: The memory shortage is hitting the gaming sphere, with Sandisk's (SNDK) PlayStation 5 storage SSD costing nearly $3,000. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 内存短缺正在影响游戏领域，Sandisk (SNDK) 的 PlayStation 5 存储 SSD 价格接近 3,000 美元。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详细介绍了这一点。

title: Uber and Lucid team up to bring robotaxis to Houston
title_zh: Uber 和 Lucid 联手将机器人出租车引入休斯顿
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins the show to discuss why Uber (UBER) and Lucid (LCID) chose Houston, Texas, as their next robotaxi market, what makes the city an attractive testing ground for autonomous ride-hailing and why there's so much riding on t...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 加入展会，讨论为什么 Uber (UBER) 和 Lucid (LCID) 选择德克萨斯州休斯顿作为他们的下一个机器人出租车市场，是什么让这座城市成为有吸引力的自动驾驶乘车测试场，以及为什么有如此多的人乘坐自动驾驶出租车。

title: SpaceX Shares Fall for First Time Since Blockbuster Debut
title_zh: SpaceX 股价自重磅上市以来首次下跌
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX shares declined for the first time since its record initial public offering, snapping a three-day rally that had reached nearly 50%.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 股价自创纪录的首次公开募股以来首次下跌，结束了连续三天上涨近 50% 的涨幅。

title: Nasdaq, US stocks slide as Fed forecasts possible rate hike
title_zh: 美联储预测可能加息，纳斯达克、美国股市下滑
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) ended Wednesday's session in negative territory after Federal Reserve officials unanimously voted to hold interest rates at their June FOMC meeting today, while also forecasting at least one possible rate hike ahead.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周三收盘下跌，此前美联储官员今天在 6 月 FOMC 会议上一致投票决定维持利率不变，同时还预测未来至少有一次可能加息。
